name: Enfield
source:
"Did you call for me, Master? I am Enfield.
I am a famous rifle, hailed as the last masterpiece of muzzle-loading guns, born from the British Empire!
The quality of the 'workshop of the world' is guaranteed! Yes!
So please, do not take my brother Snyder's words seriously...
He is plotting to remodel me...
Honestly, he is such a handful."
